steps.desc: Compile only the Detcore and Hermit test binaries used by this hardware smoke lane
steps.cmd: cargo test -p detcore --test tests_misc --no-run && cargo test -p hermit --test cli --no-run

steps.desc: CPUID-faulting smoke: Detcore masks host RDRAND/RDSEED feature bits
steps.cmd: timeout 30 cargo test -p detcore --test tests_misc rdrand_rdseed_is_masked -- --exact

steps.desc: PMU smoke: retired-conditional-branch overflow delivery and skid measurement
KVM smoke: a strict dynamic guest executes through /dev/kvm instead of ptrace
steps.cmd: timeout 30 cargo test -p hermit --test cli run_kvm_executes_dynamic_guest -- --exact --test-threads=1
